item.description: A 429 Too Many Requests error means you sent more requests or tokens than your limit allows in the current time window. OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter all return it, and it usually shows up the first time an app runs under real load or a batch job fans out across several workers.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: Grok Bot v1.0.1: Meetings, Microsoft Teams, and shared connectors
item.description: On Team, Enterprise, and Ultra plans, a Bot can join a Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams call from a link, answer in the meeting chat, and send a summary afterward. Team Bots can join Microsoft Teams: a team admin turns it on, an owner or Manager connects the Bot, and a Teams admin approves it. item.title: OpenRouter 实测 MCP vs CLI vs Skills 的上下文 token 成本 / MCP vs CLI vs Skills: What Each Costs in Context
item.description: Every tool you give an agent sends its definition to the model on every request, and you pay for it as input tokens. A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server can add tens of thousands of tokens to the context window. The usual alternatives are a command-line tool (CLI) or a skill.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.description: Bloomberg 报道 Anthropic IPO 已获数倍于发行份额的订单，主要来自大型机构投资者的锚定级意向。公司通过 IPO 加私募配售寻求最高 $90.4B，将超过 SpaceX 的 $85.7B 纪录成为史上最大上市，完全稀释估值目标约 $1.4T；Goldman Sachs 和 Morgan Stanley 牵头共 22 家银行，股票将以 ANT 在纳斯达克全球精选市场交易。（X：Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai)）

item.title: 安全公司 Claroc：94.7% 的 Grok 构建应用可被任意访问，含患者数据和 SpaceXSI 内部文件 / Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
item.description: 安全公司 Claroc 报告称，在检查的 37,571 个仍在线的 Grok 构建应用中，35,578 个（94.7%）无需登录即可访问，原因是发布对话框默认预选"Anyone with the link"，且每个应用的独立子域名会进入可检索的 passive DNS 数据库。（The Decoder：AI News（RSS））
